_material.label: Sandstone (JH-2, the project's original card)
notes: E = 6500 MPa and nu = 0.21 are exactly this card's K1 and G, so both
branches share one elasticity and the stable increment is
unambiguous. A = 90 MPa is the card's own quasi-static uniaxial
compressive strength. B, n, C, m and D1..D5 are PLACEHOLDERS.

1_single_abrasive.command: abaqus job=single_abrasive input=single_abrasive.inp user=vumat_grind.for double=both cpus=8 interactive
1_single_abrasive.what: chip thickness from the four wedge constants in the card

2_multi_abrasive.command: abaqus job=multi_abrasive input=multi_abrasive_field.inp user=vumat_grind.for double=both cpus=8 interactive
2_multi_abrasive.what: chip thickness swept per element, carried as field variable 1

3_energy_criterion.command: abaqus job=energy_criterion input=energy_criterion.inp user=vumat_grind2.for double=both cpus=8 interactive
3_energy_criterion.what: geometric split plus the local W_p L_c >= PSI Kc^2/E rule

forced_brittle.command: abaqus job=forced_brittle input=forced_brittle.inp user=vumat_grind.for double=both cpus=8 interactive
forced_brittle.why: Johnson-Holmquist II everywhere. Bit-identical to vumat_jh2.for, so this arm is the published brittle model on this geometry.

forced_ductile.command: abaqus job=forced_ductile input=forced_ductile.inp user=vumat_grind.for double=both cpus=8 interactive
forced_ductile.why: Johnson-Cook + SGE everywhere. The switch is disabled; every point is ductile regardless of its chip thickness.

geometric_hybrid.command: abaqus job=geometric_hybrid input=geometric_hybrid.inp user=vumat_grind.for double=both cpus=8 interactive
geometric_hybrid.why: the hybrid law, h from the swept field. The deck as shipped.

4_ablation._what: The same deck as 2_multi_abrasive with PROPS(56) changed and nothing else. forced_brittle is bit-identical to vumat_jh2.for, so the hybrid arm sits bracketed between two known references instead of standing alone.
